scientific_integrity: Existence and uniqueness are proved by a strictly monotone hyperbolic-sine ratio; the p=2 multiplier follows from exact algebra. The finite standalone checker is diagnostic, not a replacement for proof. A prior source already supplied the sufficient existence half of the threshold, which is expressly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Positive scalar map only; general powers p>1 classify primitive period-two points. Exact local stability regime is proved only for p=2. Nonlinear behavior at nonhyperbolic boundaries, higher periods, global basins, and the full unreduced model are not classified.
title: A unique inverse-power two-cycle and its sharp stability boundary
